about: The v9 IA error budget (analysis/roman_dchi2/v9), the correlated residual prior and Fisher method of the lssty1xdesi notes applied to the IA spectra: a random fractional error delta(X, z_s, k_i) of P_GI and P_II at 31 nodes in ln k (0.01 to 10 h/Mpc, splined) and the 13 FLAMINGO snapshots, Gaussian with rms sigma and correlation exp(-|ln k_i - ln k_j|/ell) exp(-|z_s - z_t|/L_z) (L_z = inf: the same error at every z), GI and II independent unless stated. The shifts of Omega_m and S8 follow from 1586 exact cosmolike responses (one per ln k tent and snapshot) and the Fisher matrix of the truth-as-model (Omega_m, A_s, A, eta free). sigma_max: the rms at which the rms shift of the limiting parameter reaches 0.3 of its error (eta = sqrt(1 + 0.3^2)); sigma_95: the rms at which 95% of errors keep both shifts below 0.3 sigma (the v8 criterion). 1 = no limit within 100%. example1_cov. The band for Roman 3x2pt (xi_+-, gamma_t, w; analysis/roman_dchi2/v9/ia_base_3x2.py, ia_budget_3x2.py): the same knobs, with IA in gamma_t through the GI term b_i P_dE, the 8 linear biases free (flat), the Gaussian 3x2pt covariance (cocoa/cov3x2.py) for every entry, xi_+- and gamma_t cut at k_UV = K0/D(z), w at K0 = 0.2. The error of one spectrum X confined to one k range around k_c (Gaussian window, width 0.3 in ln k), equal at every z (L_z = inf), exp kernel ell = 1: sigma_max[K0][X] (3x2pt, every lens-source pair), sigma_95[K0][X] (the same, 95% criterion), cs[K0][X] (xi_+- alone, same covariance), behind[K0][X] (3x2pt with gamma_t of sources behind lenses only). errors[K0][model][X]: P^model/P^truth - 1 at the core snapshots (z_core) on k_dense, each model fitted to the 3x2pt vector at the fiducial cosmology and biases (IA parameters only) with the same cut (fits_3x2.py). Production truth.
